scripts.shell: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest functions:shell
scripts.local-runtime:docker:wait-healthy: i=0; until curl -sf http://localhost:8090/healthz >/dev/null; do i=$((i+1)); if [ $i -ge 12 ]; then echo 'Runtime healthz nach 60s nicht erreichbar.' >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 5; done; echo 'Runtime laeuft: http://localhost:8090'
scripts.local-runtime:docker:deploy: npm run local-runtime:docker:down && npm run local-runtime:docker:up && npm run local-runtime:docker:wait-healthy
scripts.schedule:watch:local: while true; do npm run schedule:run:local; sleep 60; done
